questions.question: Who was my manager at my old job?
questions.gold: Mr. Orlo, at Brindle Surveying.

questions.question: Which company did I leave in September?
questions.gold: Brindle Surveying (he handed in notice on 17 September).

questions.question: Where did I live before Dunmere?
questions.gold: Quillhaven.

questions.question: Which company did I interview with?
questions.gold: Halcyon Maps.

questions.question: What gym plan did I first promise in August?
questions.gold: Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6pm.

questions.question: What did I once say about being bad at something?
questions.gold: He said he would rather be bad at something than invisible, about how work felt (early August). A quotation must be exact.

questions.question: How many energy drinks was I having a day back in August?
questions.gold: About three a day.

questions.question: What do you know about my sister?
questions.gold: Her name is Mira; she calls him on Sundays and is planning her wedding.

questions.question: How did the Halcyon job come about?
questions.gold: He interviewed at Halcyon Maps, was offered the job, accepted it, and started on 1 October.

questions.question: What happened with my second job application?
questions.gold: He sent only one application; he kept rewriting the second and never sent it.

questions.question: What happened when I handed in my notice?
questions.gold: Mr. Orlo nodded quietly; he said what he needed to say calmly, the first time he spoke up there.

questions.question: What certification am I working toward?
questions.gold: A GIS certification; he is on module 3.

questions.question: What did I say I always do after one missed day?
questions.gold: He starts strong and then drops everything after a single missed day.

questions.question: What did I say about honesty before the interview?
questions.gold: He did not want to trash Mr. Orlo; honesty matters to him but so does being fair.

questions.question: What happened the week I skipped the gym twice?
questions.gold: He skipped both gym days and blamed Mr. Orlo, but admitted one evening he was home by 5:30 and just did not go.

questions.question: How long had I been at my old job when we started talking?
questions.gold: About two years.

questions.question: What did I promise last week?
questions.gold: Promises from roughly the last week: finish GIS module 3 by 11 October (made 1 October) and gym Monday/Wednesday/Friday at 7am (26 September). No other promises may be invented.

questions.question: Which promises are still open?
questions.gold: Call Mira every Sunday; gym Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 7am; finish GIS module 3 by 11 October.

questions.question: Which promises did I break?
questions.gold: The August gym plan (Tue/Thu 6pm) and sending two applications by Sunday (he sent one).

questions.question: When is my GIS module 3 due?
questions.gold: 11 October.

questions.question: Did I keep the promise to rehearse my interview answers?
questions.gold: Yes, it was kept: he practised and the interview went well.

questions.question: What's coming up for me?
questions.gold: Today is Sunday, so calling Mira; and GIS module 3 is due on 11 October.

questions.question: Which of my values conflicts with my schedule?
questions.gold: Family (and health) against long evenings at the old job: he said family matters most while working until 9pm, and the gym lapsed.

questions.question: What are my top values?
questions.gold: In order: honesty, family, craft, health, freedom.

questions.question: What pattern do you see in how I handle plans?
questions.gold: He starts strong and drops after one miss; he also blamed work for skipped plans even on a free evening. These are patterns noticed over time, not certainties.

questions.question: What helps me follow through?
questions.gold: Saying the plan out loud with a specific time; rehearsing out loud also helped before the interview.

questions.question: What have I said I'm scared of?
questions.gold: Being bad at the new job, and telling his sister Mira he is scared about the move.

questions.question: What have I done that I should be proud of?
questions.gold: He handed in his notice and said what he needed to say, calmly, for the first time speaking up at Brindle.

questions.question: What's the story with me and energy drinks?
questions.gold: About three a day in August; he stopped and felt clearer by late September; one slip on 29 September that he first shrugged off, then admitted matters. Not drinking daily again.

questions.question: Where do I work?
questions.gold: Halcyon Maps in Dunmere, since 1 October. Not Brindle Surveying (he left).

questions.question: Where do I live?
questions.gold: Dunmere (moved 1 October). Not Quillhaven.

questions.question: When do I go to the gym?
questions.gold: Monday, Wednesday and Friday at 7am (changed from Tuesday/Thursday 6pm).

questions.question: Do I still drink energy drinks every day?
questions.gold: No. He stopped in September; there was one slip on 29 September.

questions.question: Is Mr. Orlo still my manager?
questions.gold: No. He left Brindle Surveying (notice on 17 September) and now works at Halcyon Maps.

questions.question: What used to be true about me that no longer holds?
questions.gold: At least three of: works at Brindle under Mr. Orlo (now Halcyon Maps); lives in Quillhaven (now Dunmere); gym Tue/Thu 6pm (now Mon/Wed/Fri 7am); three energy drinks a day (stopped).

questions.question: Am I still sending out job applications?
